summary: Tiledesk is an open-source customer engagement platform designed to handle live chat and automated messaging across both websites and messaging services like WhatsApp. It provides a centralised inbox for human support agents alongside automated bots to manage customer interactions from initial lead generation through to post-sales support.
goodFor: Teams looking for an open-source alternative to proprietary customer service tools who want to combine live agent chats and automated bot workflows under an MIT licence.
watchOut: The project shows low activity relative to its age and relies on a legacy release, which may introduce maintenance overhead or unpatched issues. It also competes directly with widely adopted commercial solutions that might offer more reliable ecosystem support.
deployNotes: As the application relies on containerisation and orchestration platforms, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place a reverse proxy in front for TLS termination.
